_decision: 2026-08-12: the adult-facing pages may carry the estate's existing Ko-fi support pill in their footer. Ruled by Matt in the support-buttons pass. One record, three consumers - render_audience_homepages.py, render_discovery_hubs.py and verify_games_audience_faces.py - so the pill cannot drift between the surfaces that carry it. Same class as studioBand in audience-homepages.json: a declared editorial input, not a derived value.
_hrefProvenance: Extracted, never invented. https://ko-fi.com/madebymattuk is the single Ko-fi destination already published on / (studio band, 'Support the work'), /main/, /tools/ and /resources/. Byte-identical to all four at e06a9e4. Nothing about the URL is shortened, redirected or improved.
_copyProvenance: Extracted, never invented. The lead sentence and the pill label are the wording already shipped inside <div class="mbm-kofi"> on /main/ and /resources/ at e06a9e4, carried across verbatim. /tools/ carries the same block with 'If a tool has saved you an evening'; the general 'lesson or tool' variant is the one adopted here because the pages that now gain the pill are not tool pages.
_treatment: A plain anchor, and only ever a plain anchor. No Ko-fi widget, script or iframe: no off-origin request may fire at page load on any surface, which is the property verify_audience_discovery_browser.py asserts and whose allow-list this pass does not touch. A plain link fires nothing until it is clicked.
_printNote: No print rule is added anywhere. Every page that carries this pill loads /styles.css, whose @media print rule already hides both .footer and .mbm-kofi, and the pill sits inside the footer. Adding an equivalent rule to assets/mbm-platform.css would have been dead CSS - checked against all eight pages, not assumed.
_focusNote: No focus CSS is added either. styles.css carries a global :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--a);outline-offset:4px} and --a is #F2A24A, so the ring is amber against the pill's #161D3D card and is visible without a new rule.
_excludedSurfaces: /for/pupils/ carries data-mbm-adult-features="off" and never receives this pill; check_support_pill() in verify_games_audience_faces.py asserts it carries zero Ko-fi hrefs, in both directions. /resources/ is pupil-reachable through the pupil homepage's no-JS search fallback (action="/resources/") and is not a target of this pass.
